# Haseen Ullah — HSE Officer

## Professional focus
- Health, Safety & Environment (HSE)
- Hazard identification and risk assessment
- HSE compliance and workplace inspections
- Safety audits and corrective actions
- Toolbox talks, inductions and safety awareness
- Incident and near-miss investigation
- Root cause analysis and CAPA
- Work at Height, lifting, excavation, hot work and electrical safety
- Emergency response and documentation
